description: In QBlade's Direct Foil Design module, generate two parent airfoils: a NACA 2412 (2% camber, 40% position, 12% thickness) and a NACA 4424 (4% camber, 40% position, 24% thickness). Then, use the 'Interpolate Foils' feature to create a new airfoil that is a 50% blend between these two. Export the resulting interpolated airfoil coordinates to '/home/ga/Documents/airfoils/interpolated_naca_50pct.dat'. Ensure the exported file uses the standard Selig format (name in first line, then coordinates).
